svg.title: Valen ecosystem
svg.desc: Valen-Decision-1.5 at the centre: text, images and video plus questions go in, typed answers (predicate, choice, score, bbox) come out. Around it: SDKs, agent skill and workflow integrations; runtimes from the hosted API to vLLM, SGLang, ONNX Runtime, llama.cpp and Ollama; evaluation with JevalKit and VisualDecisionBench; and Roller and Awesome-RSI for agents and recursive self-improvement.
